players.product: multi-beam and single-beam electron-beam mask writers and spot-beam electron-beam lithography systems (Industrial Equipment); TEM / FIB systems for semiconductor inspection

quarterly_data.signal: Product launch: benchtop scanning electron microscope JCM-7000Plus NeoScope, sales beginning September 1, 2026; landing voltage expanded to 20 kV, resolution 6 nm (secondary electron image) and 8 nm (backscattered electron image), improved backscattered electron detector, new Live Particle and Live Report functions and Neo Action automation; sales target 300 units/year.
quarterly_data.figure: 20 kV; 6 nm / 8 nm resolution; sales target 300 units/year
